results.title: Teacher table renders strictly 5 columns and omits long stats columns
results.details: Columns: Tên, Email, Lớp đang phụ trách, Trạng thái, Thao tác

results.title: Clicking "Xem / Sửa" opens TeacherDetailDrawer displaying deep stats in Tabs 3, 4, 5
Only a single "+ Tạo giáo viên" button exists on the page (no duplicate toolbar button)
220ms debounced server-side search queries backend and renders matched teacher
Mobile card layout at 390px viewport displays essential fields with zero horizontal overflow
DELETE /api/ktn/teachers enforces admin authorization (returns 401/403 for non-admins)
Deleting teacher immediately invalidates existing teacher session token (403 on subsequent requests)
Deleting teacher automatically unassigns related classes in database state
Clicking "Xóa" opens 1-step confirmation dialog with no email/code input required
Confirming delete updates teacher table and closes drawer immediately without page reload (F5)
ClassScheduleModal renders single combobox input that supports typing to filter and clicking to open list
Unaccented Vietnamese search ("quoc bao") matches accented teacher name ("Thầy Đặng Quốc Bảo"), email, and code
Full keyboard navigation: ArrowDown/Up to highlight, Enter to select without modal form submit, Esc to close
Selecting "Chưa phân công giáo viên" assigns empty value and keeps compatibility
Dropdown menu renders with high z-index and does not clip or overflow on 390px mobile viewport
Special characters, HTML tags, SQL fragments, and emojis do not crash UI or execute XSS
Searching for non-existent teacher displays clean empty state message without breaking layout
Teacher with 0 assigned classes renders cleanly with "Chưa phân công lớp" badge and no null errors
Long teacher names and email addresses truncate gracefully without breaking cell borders
Rapid search input thrashing cancels prior in-flight requests without race-condition DOM rendering
Deleting a teacher assigned to multiple classes unassigns all classes and reports exact count
Calling DELETE on non-existent or already-deleted teacher returns safe 404 without server crash
Upstream izTeach sync failure handles gracefully with syncStatus: "needs_sync" while completing soft-delete
Concurrent DELETE requests for the same teacher resolve safely without deadlock or corruption
Clicking "Hủy" or pressing Esc in delete confirmation dialog dismisses dialog with 0 mutation calls
Typing arbitrary text and clicking outside (blur) without selecting restores previous teacher value unchanged
Inactive and soft-deleted teachers are strictly excluded from combobox options list
Keyboard navigation wraps cleanly at list boundaries and Enter on unselected item does not corrupt value
Reopening modal after closing with unsaved combobox changes restores original saved teacher assignment
Query with zero matches displays "Không tìm thấy giáo viên" and disables selection
Delete Teacher A -> Admin table removes row -> Class schedule combobox excludes Teacher A
Delete Teacher B assigned to Class X -> Combobox displays "Chưa phân công" -> Admin classes table reflects unassigned
Search Teacher C in search bar -> Open Drawer -> Delete from Drawer -> Drawer closes and table removes Teacher C
Assign Teacher D to Class Y in ClassScheduleModal via Combobox -> Saved assignment reflects immediately in admin table
Delete Teacher E -> Open formerly assigned Class Z modal -> Reassign to Teacher F via unaccented combobox search
Combobox opened while teacher is concurrently deleted -> UI handles gracefully without unhandled exception
Desktop 1440x900 Complete Admin Lifecycle Workflow (5-col table -> Drawer stats -> Combobox schedule -> Deletion & zero-reload)
Mobile 390x844 Responsive Touch & Zero-Overflow Workflow (compact cards -> touch combobox -> mobile delete confirmation -> zero horizontal scroll)
Historical Data & Student Integrity Workflow (100% preservation of student accounts, classes, chat, and homework after teacher deletion)
